question: How many years and volumes do you think you will need to reach the end?
answer: I once said I wanted to finish it in 37 volumes, the same volume that The Adventures of Dai (Dragon Quest Manga) ended. However, the next volume is Volume 30, and it is impossible to finish it within the next 7 volumes, so you will have to bear with it longer. I hope I don’t go all the way to Volume 50, but the possibility exists. I don’t plan to continue for another 10 years.
